hook.name: HopforgeFeeHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that taxes 1.5% of every swap on registered Hopforge ETH/token pools, splitting fees between a referrer (10%), token creator (20%), token holder reflection pool (30%), and platform treasury (40%) via the ERC6909 mint/burn pattern. Referrers are attributed via tx.origin and optional hookData; harvesting holder rewards is gated by a block delay to prevent flash-loan attacks.
